function.name: qualify_job
function.description: Validate service type, suburb and hazard/escalation rules before any booking attempt.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Return real bookable slots. Never infer availability without this tool.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book one previously returned slot. Requires an opaque slot_token from check_availability.

function.name: notify_business
function.description: Send a concise lead/call summary to the business after handling the enquiry.

function.name: human_escalation
function.description: Use for hazards, complaints, human requests, uncertain policy, or any case that must not be handled autonomously.
